metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the binding at Hewlands and the table after you were back.

yesterday: The shoe went on. You were out at six and done at four, with an hour for dinner when Bartholomew called it.
The ears were short. The stooks stood with ground between them.
Two-and-twenty shillings the quarter was Quiney's figure, and thirty by Christmas was his. Anne gave the town's side.
You will give what you can give. Your lord's ear is kept for plays. Both fires are to go in one brief.
The children kept the burned row for Thursday.
